title: Roquan Smith 2023 Panini Prizm Baltimore Ravens #21 Base
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Roquan Smith 2023 Panini Prizm trading card features the Baltimore Ravens #21 base set. The card showcases vibrant colors and a sleek design, making it a must-have for any NFL fan's collection. With its standard size and English language, this card is perfect for displaying or trading. The card is an original and licensed reprint, manufactured in the United States by Panini.

The card does not have any autographs, but it still captures the essence of the football franchise. It is a great addition to any collection and a perfect gift for football enthusiasts. Get your hands on this Roquan Smith 2023 Panini Prizm trading card and add a touch of the NFL to your collection today!
